seo.title: Founder’s note | Steps AI
seo.description: Why Steps AI exists: so that a customer’s question never costs a business the sale.

hero.title: A customer’s question should never cost a business the sale.
hero.body: Steps AI was founded in 2024 by Reshmanth Jonnalagadda. This note explains why we built it and what we will not compromise on.

sections.title: Why we built Steps AI.
paragraphs: Small business owners answer the same questions all day. Where is my order. Do you ship here. Can I return this. They answer on the website, then on Instagram, then on WhatsApp, often late at night because that is when people shop.
Many have tried a chatbot and switched it off when it recited a return policy to someone asking about a parcel. We built Steps AI to check the order instead.

sections.title: What we will not compromise on.

items.title: Real answers
items.body: The agent looks things up in your store and tools instead of guessing from a web page.

items.title: Knowing when to stop
items.body: When the agent does not know, it says so and passes the conversation to a person.

items.title: Honest pricing and limits
items.body: We tell you what a reply costs and where Steps AI is not the right fit.

cta.title: Talk to us about your business.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through your customers’ questions with you.
